sub_site: ORIEN pan-cancer tumour RNA-seq; eligible types: LUAD, LUSC, SCLC, other lung, PAAD/other pancreatic, sarcoma, melanoma (SKCM), thyroid (THCA)

data_source.dataset: ORIEN Avatar tumour RNA-seq (exotic pipeline microbe abundances)

evidence.quote: RNA-seq reads are used to calculate microbe abundances using the (exotic) pipeline
reads are aligned first to the human reference genome, and then unaligned reads are mapped to a database of bacteria, fungi, archaea, viruses, and eukaryotic parasites

decontamination.tool: exotic pipeline contaminant filtering + batch correction; 0.1% abundance filter

evidence.quote: The observed microbes then proceed through a series of filtering steps to carefully and conservatively remove contaminants before batch correction and normalization.

notes: Deep-learning (MEGA) tool paper on 2,704 ORIEN tumour RNA-seq samples, 12 cancer types; per-type sample counts not given in main text, so n_target_samples null. Only THCA genera (Pseudomonas, Staphylococcus; S. aureus also shared across all 12 types) named for eligible types; F. nucleatum reported in lung/pancreatic cancers but written only as 'F. nucleatum' in Results (genus name not spelled out there), so not recorded. Full species lists in Supplementary Tables S1-S3 (not available). 16S validation set is colorectal (not eligible).
